meta.name: draft-pr
meta.description: Prepare commits, push a branch, and create a draft PR targeting your base branch.

copy.tagline: 自动创建草稿PR并推送分支
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从本地提交代码并创建PR
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create draft PRs and push branches
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to commit code and create PRs

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求创建草稿 Pull Request 时，Claude 会自动准备代码提交、推送分支，并创建一个针对基础分支的草稿 PR。它会使用约定提交格式生成提交信息，最后提示进行代码评审。
howto.when: 当你说“帮我创建一个草稿 PR”或输入 /draft-pr 时触发。默认在 Developer 模式下运行。

say.text: 帮我创建当前分支的草稿 PR。
say.note: Claude 将执行完整流程并创建 PR。

howto.what_en: When you request to create a draft Pull Request, Claude automatically prepares commits, pushes a branch, and creates a draft PR targeting your base branch. It uses conventional commit messages and ends with a code review prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'Create a draft PR' or issue the /draft-pr command. Runs in Developer mode by default.

say_en.text: Create a draft PR for the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full workflow and create the PR.

say_en.text: Use 'feat(frontend): add button' as commit message and create PR.
say_en.note: Claude will use the specified commit message.
